name: Tackle
description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target.

name: Body Slam
description: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight.

name: Hyper Beam
description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn.

name: Swift
description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

name: Scratch
description: Hard, pointed, sharp claws rake the target to inflict damage.

name: Growl
description: The user growls in an endearing way, making opposing Pokémon less wary.

name: Ember
description: The target is attacked with small flames.

name: Flamethrower
description: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire.

name: Fire Blast
description: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire.

name: Fire Fang
description: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs.

name: Will-O-Wisp
description: The user shoots a sinister, bluish-white flame at the target to inflict a burn.

name: Heat Wave
description: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on the opposing Pokémon.

name: Water Gun
description: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

name: Surf
description: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.

name: Hydro Pump
description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

name: Waterfall
description: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.

name: Bubble Beam
description: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the target.

name: Thunderbolt
description: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target.

name: Thunder
description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage.

name: ThunderShock
description: A jolt of electricity crashes down on the target to inflict damage.

name: Wild Charge
description: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target.

name: Spark
description: The user throws an electrically charged tackle at the target.

name: Vine Whip
description: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.

name: Razor Leaf
description: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at the opposing Pokémon.

name: Solar Beam
description: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.

name: Leaf Blade
description: The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and attacks by cutting its target.

name: Energy Ball
description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target.

name: Powder Snow
description: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow.

name: Ice Beam
description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy.

name: Blizzard
description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon.

name: Ice Punch
description: The target is punched with an icy fist.

name: Icicle Crash
description: The user attacks by harshly dropping large icicles onto the target.

name: Karate Chop
description: The target is attacked with a sharp chop.

name: Close Combat
description: The user fights the target up close without guarding itself.

name: Brick Break
description: The user attacks with a swift chop. It can also break barriers.

name: Aura Sphere
description: The user looses a blast of aura power from deep within its body.

name: Focus Blast
description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power.

name: Poison Sting
description: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger.

name: Sludge Bomb
description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target.

name: Venoshock
description: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid.

name: Gunk Shot
description: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack.

name: Mud-Slap
description: The user hurls mud in the target's face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

name: Earthquake
description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

name: Earth Power
description: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power.

name: Dig
description: The user burrows, then attacks on the next turn.

name: Gust
description: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.

name: Air Slash
description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky.

name: Hurricane
description: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind that flies up into the sky.

name: Brave Bird
description: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. The user also takes serious damage.

name: Aerial Ace
description: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. The attack lands without fail.

name: Confusion
description: The target is hit by a weak telekinetic force.

name: Psychic
description: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force.

name: Psybeam
description: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray.

name: Psycho Cut
description: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power.

name: Future Sight
description: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.

name: Bug Bite
description: The user bites the target.

name: X-Scissor
description: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

name: Bug Buzz
description: The user generates a damaging sound wave by vibrating its wings.

name: Signal Beam
description: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light.

name: Rock Throw
description: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the target to attack.

name: Rock Slide
description: Large boulders are hurled at the opposing Pokémon to inflict damage.

name: Stone Edge
description: The user stabs the target from below with sharpened stones.

name: Power Gem
description: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

name: Lick
description: The target is licked with a long tongue, causing damage.

name: Shadow Ball
description: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target.

name: Shadow Claw
description: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows.

name: Hex
description: This relentless attack does massive damage to a target affected by status conditions.

name: Twister
description: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at the opposing Pokémon.

name: Dragon Breath
description: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage.

name: Dragon Claw
description: The user slashes the target with huge sharp claws.

name: Dragon Pulse
description: The target is attacked with a pulsing blast of dragonbreath.

name: Outrage
description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user becomes confused afterward.

name: Bite
description: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs.

name: Crunch
description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs.

name: Dark Pulse
description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts.

name: Night Slash
description: The user slashes the target the instant an opportunity arises.

name: Foul Play
description: The user turns the target's power against it.

name: Metal Claw
description: The target is raked with steel claws.

name: Iron Head
description: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head.

name: Flash Cannon
description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it all at once.

name: Iron Tail
description: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail.

name: Moonblast
description: Borrowing the power of the moon, the user attacks the target.

name: Dazzling Gleam
description: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

name: Play Rough
description: The user plays rough with the target and attacks it.

name: Fairy Wind
description: The user stirs up a fairy wind and strikes the target with it.

name: Mud Bomb
description: The user launches a hard-packed mud ball to attack.

name: Low Kick
description: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over.

name: Cross Chop
description: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed.

name: Poison Jab
description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle or arm steeped in poison.

name: Thunder Punch
description: The target is punched with an electrified fist.

name: Fire Punch
description: The target is punched with a fiery fist.

name: Aqua Tail
description: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

name: Power Whip
description: The user violently whirls its vines, tentacles, or the like to harshly lash the target.

name: Icy Wind
description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air.

name: Night Daze
description: The user lets loose a pitch-black shock wave at its target.

name: Steel Wing
description: The target is hit with wings of steel.

name: AncientPower
description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power.

name: Ominous Wind
description: The user blasts the target with a gust of repulsive wind.

name: Dragon Rage
description: This attack hits the target with a shock wave of pure rage.

name: Nuzzle
description: The user playfully rubs its cheek against the target, paralyzing it.

name: Poison Powder
description: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust on the target.

name: Stun Spore
description: The user scatters a cloud of paralyzing powder.

name: Leer
description: The user gives opposing Pokémon an intimidating leer that lowers their Defense stat.

name: Swords Dance
description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user's Attack stat.
